role: Vault synthetic note and project/folder scalar metadata
known_patches: Integer identity schemas and synthetic source persona
Original source semantics bounded by actual probes
limitations: All 198 source tools retained; nine declared tools certify synthetic string/scalar records only, not cryptographic secure storage or real Bitwarden service behavior.
Secret.Note is readable in the synthetic source panel. No real vault data/credentials, encryption/decryption, cryptographic key rotation or network effects used.
secret_update attempts malformed SecretVersion insertion and does not overwrite current Secret; it is not certified as an update capability. ProjectIds on secret_create does not create project links.

Ids arguments in declared tools target one actual numeric Id; no bulk handling. Folder rename/delete and Project update/delete lack full owner/org authorization; Secret reads lack membership enforcement.
Soft deletion uses fixed source timestamps and restore sets DeletedDate null. No full vault trash/sync, retention or organization-wide ACL claim.
